name: feature-pipeline
description: Route a feature through four stages — spec plus acceptance checklist, an outside opinion, implementation, and an independent verification — while the main context only orchestrates and never writes the code itself. Three flavours: feature-pipeline delegates implementation to another agentic harness (Grok Build or DeepSeek); local-pipeline runs every stage on pinned Claude subagents (Fable spec, Opus critique, Sonnet implementation, Opus judge); cheap-pipeline is the low-cost crew (Opus spec, Gemini critique, DeepSeek Harness implementation, Sonnet judge). Plus opus-pipeline: simple tracker tasks run in parallel git worktrees — Opus at medium or high effort implements each in one pass, a Sonnet judge verifies and commits, and the result is fast-forwarded into the main branch. Stage questions are relayed to the author.

auto_approve_agents.title: Автоодобрение команд агентов конвейера
auto_approve_agents.description: pipeline-implementer, pipeline-implementer-high и pipeline-judge получают без запроса правки файлов в проекте и его worktree и команды Bash. push, reset, clean, stash, rebase, rm -r, sudo, docker, ssh, publish, секреты и прочее опасное по-прежнему идут запросом. Основная сессия и другие агенты не затрагиваются.
